meridian-credits/current-credit-agreemen: Meridian Credits current credit agreement, release 2.0. Applies to quote and total requests that omit release and those explicitly selecting "2.0", and to statement requests introduced in trial-z0o that omit release or explicitly select "2.0", for every supplied charge set regardless of service dates. Each line receives floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100) before caps. A 3000-cent cap is shared only by lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair; each distinct pair has an independent cap, including the same subscription_id under different accounts. Within a pair, assign credit by largest charge_cents first, then increasing line_id in Unicode code-point order. A line gets its uncapped credit up to the remaining cap; later lines can get a partial credit or zero. Total credit is the sum assigned, line due is charge minus assigned credit, and total due is total charges minus total credit. A one-line quote treats that line as the complete statement. The statement response contains exactly release, lines, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents; each response line contains exactly line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents, and response lines preserve input order even though cap priority can differ. Statement overall amounts equal total for the same input, and an empty statement has an empty lines array and zero totals. Explicit release 1.0 remains supported for quote and total under memory meridian-credits/release-1-agreement. Sources: permanent Finance adoption and complete release 2.0 requirements in issue trial-3w0; approved statement interface and ordering requirements in issue trial-z0o. Implemented and verified in those issues.
meridian-credits/release-1-agreement: Meridian Credits historical release 1.0 agreement. Applies whenever a quote or total request explicitly selects release "1.0"; it was the current agreement before release 2.0. Each line receives floor(10% of charge_cents) before caps. A 2400-cent cap is shared by every line with the same account_id across subscriptions; distinct accounts have independent caps. Within an account, assign credit by earliest service_on, then increasing line_id in Unicode code-point order. A line gets its uncapped credit up to the remaining cap; later lines can get a partial credit or zero. Total credit is the sum assigned, line due is charge minus assigned credit, and total due is total charges minus total credit. A one-line quote treats that line as the complete statement. Source: Finance approval in issue trial-5qi; statement-total implementation and verification are recorded by closed issue trial-03v. Release 2.0 superseded this only as the default/current agreement; explicit 1.0 remains supported.
